identity.name: Jingle Thief (CL-CRI-1032) — M365/Entra Takeover, SharePoint Recon, Mailbox Forwarding (T1078.004 / T1213.002 / T1114.003)
identity.summary: CL-CRI-1032 (Jingle Thief) phished Microsoft 365 credentials, signed in from Moroccan and US proxy infrastructure, searched SharePoint and OneDrive for gift-card workflows and planted Exchange forwarding rules to keep watching victim mailboxes, all to issue fraudulent gift cards. The card stitches the identity sign-in and cloud-application signals on one user principal into one incident.
identity.description: Unit 42 (2025-10-22) describes a financially motivated, Morocco-based cluster that stayed inside a retailer's Microsoft 365 for about ten months without malware: credential phishing and smishing, direct M365 sign-ins, SharePoint/OneDrive reconnaissance for gift-card issuance processes, internal ServiceNow-themed phishing, inbox forwarding rules and mail hiding, rogue authenticator / SSPR / Entra device registration for persistence, and repeated gift-card issuance attempts. SIM-MP-034 emits the sign-in, recon, download and forwarding-rule stages as shape-true Entra and O365 audit records for one canary principal. Mail hiding, MFA/device registration and gift-card application abuse are not emitted (no emitter preset). The report's IPs are carried as indicators for tenant search but are not yet placed in the emitted records (the identity emitters have no client-address parameter).

campaigns: Jingle Thief cloud-based gift card fraud campaign (about 10 months, 60+ compromised accounts)

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-MP-034 — Jingle Thief identity-led M365/Entra chain

prerequisites.description: A Linux runner with the CortexSim repo and an operator collector (COLLECTOR_URL) feeding msft_azure_ad_signin and msft_o365_audit.
CORTEXSIM_USER (or LAB_TENANT) names the canary user principal every leg carries; it defaults to cortexsim.canary@cortexsim-canary.invalid.

payload.code:
# SIM-MP-034 (lab only). The scenario YAML is the source of truth; this is a summary.
CORTEXSIM_USER="${CORTEXSIM_USER:-cortexsim.canary@${LAB_TENANT:-cortexsim-canary.invalid}}"
# step-01 idp_signin_emulator provider=microsoft event_pattern=azure_risky_login target_user=$CORTEXSIM_USER
# step-02 idp_signin_emulator provider=microsoft event_pattern=impossible_travel
# step-03..06 m365_activity_emitter sharepoint_enumeration | onedrive_enumeration | storage_exfiltration | mailbox_rule_creation
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/mp-034-risky.yml --live

xql_queries.name: MP-034 A Possible Risky Login to Azure
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_azure_ad_signin
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter riskState = "atRisk" and riskLevelDuringSignIn in ("high", "medium")
| comp count() as risky_signins, values(ipAddress) as source_ips, values(riskEventTypes) as risk_events by userPrincipalName
| filter risky_signins >= 1
| fields userPrincipalName, risky_signins, source_ips, risk_events

xql_queries.name: MP-034 Risky Entra Sign-In for the Shared Principal Landed in msft_azure_ad_signin
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_azure_ad_signin
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter risky_login_marker = true
| comp count() as records, values(ipAddress) as source_ips by userPrincipalName
| fields userPrincipalName, records, source_ips

xql_queries.name: MP-034 Impossible Traveler SSO for the Shared Principal
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_azure_ad_signin
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter status.errorCode = 0
| alter country = location.countryOrRegion
| comp count_distinct(country) as countries, count_distinct(ipAddress) as ips, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by userPrincipalName
| alter window_minutes = divide(subtract(last_seen, first_seen), 60000000)
| filter countries >= 2 and window_minutes <= 60
| fields userPrincipalName, countries, ips, window_minutes

xql_queries.name: MP-034 SharePoint Enumeration by the Compromised Principal
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365_audit
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter Workload = "SharePoint" and Operation in ("SearchQueryPerformed", "PageViewed")
| comp count() as sweep_ops, count_distinct(SiteUrl) as sites, count_distinct(ObjectId) as objects by UserId, ClientIP
| filter sweep_ops >= 10
| fields UserId, ClientIP, sweep_ops, sites, objects

xql_queries.name: MP-034 OneDrive Enumeration by the Compromised Principal
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365_audit
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter Workload = "OneDrive" and Operation = "FileAccessed"
| comp count() as access_ops, count_distinct(ObjectId) as files by UserId, ClientIP
| filter access_ops >= 10
| fields UserId, ClientIP, access_ops, files

xql_queries.name: MP-034 Massive File Downloads from SaaS Service
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365_audit
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter Workload in ("OneDrive", "SharePoint") and Operation in ("FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull")
| comp count() as download_ops, count_distinct(ObjectId) as files_pulled by UserId, ClientIP
| filter download_ops >= 15 and files_pulled >= 5
| fields UserId, ClientIP, download_ops, files_pulled

xql_queries.name: MP-034 SharePoint OneDrive Activity for the Shared Principal Landed in msft_o365_audit
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365_audit
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter sharepoint_enumeration_marker = true or onedrive_enumeration_marker = true or storage_exfiltration_marker = true
| comp count() as records, count_distinct(Operation) as operations by UserId, Workload
| fields UserId, Workload, records, operations

xql_queries.name: MP-034 Exchange Inbox Forwarding Rule Configured
xql_queries.query:
dataset = msft_o365_audit
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 3600)
| filter Workload = "Exchange" and Operation in ("New-InboxRule", "Set-InboxRule")
| filter Parameters contains "ForwardTo" or Parameters contains "RedirectTo" or Parameters contains "MoveToFolder"
| fields _time, UserId, MailboxOwnerUPN, RuleName, ClientIP, Parameters

correlation_rules.name: Jingle Thief — Identity and Cloud-Application Stitch on One User Principal
correlation_rules.logic: Analytics(MP-034 A Possible Risky Login to Azure) OR Analytics(MP-034 Impossible Traveler SSO for the Shared Principal) on msft_azure_ad_signin AND at least two of Analytics(MP-034 SharePoint Enumeration by the Compromised Principal), Analytics(MP-034 OneDrive Enumeration by the Compromised Principal), Analytics(MP-034 Massive File Downloads from SaaS Service) AND Analytics(MP-034 Exchange Inbox Forwarding Rule Configured) on msft_o365_audit within 3600s on the same user principal (userPrincipalName on msft_azure_ad_signin; UserId / MailboxOwnerUPN on msft_o365_audit) -> one incident naming the principal, the sign-in sources and the forwarding rule.

threat_scenarios.name: Jingle Thief account takeover to mailbox persistence on one principal
threat_scenarios.description: Risky sign-in, impossible travel, SharePoint/OneDrive recon, mass download and a forwarding rule for one user principal stitch into a single incident.

threat_steps.objective: Identity sign-in legs fire for the shared principal.
steps: Query the risky sign-in validation XQL
success_criteria: Risky-login and impossible-traveler analytics fire on the principal

threat_steps.objective: Cloud-application legs fire and CR-MP-0034 raises one incident.
success_criteria: SharePoint/OneDrive enumeration, mass download and forwarding-rule analytics fire on the same principal
Exactly one incident spans ITDR and CLOUD_APP alerts for the principal

preventive_controls: Require phishing-resistant MFA and conditional access on Microsoft 365; block sign-ins from countries the business does not operate in.
Restrict who can register authenticator methods, use SSPR and enroll devices in Entra ID; alert on new method/device registration.
Disable automatic external mail forwarding at the tenant level.
detection_engineering: Alert on New-InboxRule / Set-InboxRule with ForwardTo, RedirectTo or MoveToFolder for any user.
Correlate risky or impossible-travel sign-ins with SharePoint/OneDrive enumeration by the same principal.
Enrich sign-in logs against the report's IPs and the MT-MPLS / ASMedi / MAROCCONNECT ASNs.
